name: Ai Craftsman Superpowers
description:
Senior craftsman methodology for Claude Code. 22 commands, 12 specialized agents, and automated hooks that enforce DDD, Clean Architecture, and TDD practices. Includes 3-level code
validation (regex + static analysis + architecture), semantic intelligence via agent hooks, bias protection, correction learning, Sentry channel integration, and framework-specific scaffolding for Symfony/PHP and React/TypeScript.
longDescription:
Ships **18 skills**, **6 agents** and **12 hooks**.

- **Skills** (18): `challenge` (Senior architecture review and code challenge), `ci` (CI/CD pipeline integration), `debug` (Systematic debugging using ReAct pattern), `design` (Senior Domain-Driven Design methodology), `git` (Safe git workflow with destructive command protection), `healthcheck` (Run a comprehensive diagnostic of your Craftsman plugin installation and runtime), `legacy` (Legacy code rescue - audit hotspots, cover with characterization tests, break dependencies, and plan strangler-fig migrations), `metrics` (Quality metrics and local dashboard), and 10 more
- **Agents** (6): `architect` (Senior software architect - deep expertise in DDD (strategic + tactical), CQRS, Clean Architecture, Event-Driven Architecture, and system…), `doc-writer` (Senior technical writer - generates and reviews API docs (OpenAPI), ADRs, READMEs, runbooks, and user guides), `legacy-surgeon` (Legacy code surgeon - brings untested, tangled, inherited code under control without breaking it), `security-pentester` (Security specialist for finding vulnerabilities in code), `team-lead` (CTO & Tech Lead clone - orchestrates specialized teams across all projects), `ui-ux-director` (UI/UX director and design system guardian - deep expertise in SaaS dashboard UX, data visualization, accessibility WCAG 2.1…)
- **Hooks** (12): `SessionStart`, `PreToolUse`, `PostToolUse`, `TaskCompleted`, `PostToolUseFailure`, `UserPromptSubmit`, `FileChanged`, `SubagentStop`, and 4 more

Installs with `claude plugin install ai-craftsman-superpowers@claude-community` from `BULDEE/ai-craftsman-superpowers`.
